Built-in MagSafe magnets snap onto compatible phones, cases, and PopSockets mounts for seamless attachment and removal. The comfortable, ergonomic grip flexes with your fingers for one-handed use while texting, scrolling, or commuting. Built to last with a high-strength aluminum base and stainless steel kickstand. Compatible with iPhone 12 and newer, MagSafe and Qi2-compatible phone cases, MagSafe and Qi2 wireless chargers, and PopSockets magnetic mounts.
